Title: Pupilfirst is at the vanguard of the digital transformation of Indian classroom education.

URL Source: https://pupilfirst.com/

Markdown Content:
[![Image 1: pupilfirst.logo](https://pupilfirst.com/pupilfirst.svg)](https://pupilfirst.com/)

The Indian classroom education system will soon be the largest in the world. It is a complex ecosystem that is difficult to visualize. However, the simplest unit of this ecosystem is also its most important one - the classroom.

What we do

## The Gold Standard for Engineering Education

The All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), the statutory body for technical education in India, has approved our curriculums as national model curriculums. The reason they’ve done so is that students who finished our courses are working on life-saving essential tools that have been recognized by the United Nations as a Digital Public Good.

![Image 2: Image of a digital war room for disaster management. People are working on laptops in front of a large LED wall that displays a dashboard of COVID-19 statistics.](https://pupilfirst.com/home/Digital-warroom.jpg)

SINCE 2021

### Digital War Rooms for   
disaster management.

The skills learned by our students were demonstrated through the rapid scaling of COVID war-rooms with oxygen management capabilities during the height of the COVID-19 pandemic.

[Read More](https://ohc.network/)

![Image 3: Image of a doctor is on a video call with another doctor on a mobile phone. The doctor is in front of a laptop that is displaying a dashboard of the CARE software. The dashboard shows a live view of a remote ICU.](https://pupilfirst.com/home/TeleICU.png)

SINCE 2022

### TeleICU Systems Empowering Healthcare Professionals.

To overcome the acute shortage of healthcare professionals in district hospitals of rural and remote India, our students have built TeleICU systems that connect them to medical colleges in state capitals.

[Read More](https://ohc.network/teleicu)

![Image 4: Ayushma AI](https://pupilfirst.com/home/Ayushma-AI.png)

SINCE MAY 2023

### Ayushma AI: Empowering Nurses with Multilingual ICU Protocols.

Leveraging the recent rapid advancements in AI technology, our students are building multilingual interfaces that assist nurses in rapidly upgrading their knowledge about ICU protocols.

[Read More](https://ohc.network/ayushma)

OUR GOAL

## Mandate to Scale

Because we've established the gold standard for education, while being aligned with the National Education Policy, we received a mandate from AICTE to scale our tools and curriculum to train:

1 Lakh

Teachers

![Image 5](https://pupilfirst.com/icons/LITE-classroom-icon.svg)

![Image 6: Icon of a teacher and students in a classroom.](https://pupilfirst.com/icons/neon-circle.svg)

24 Million

Students

A SHARED VISION

## LITE envisions the future of classrooms

The All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), the statutory body for technical education in India, has approved our curriculums as national model curriculums. The reason they’ve done so is that students who finished our courses are working on life-saving essential tools that have been recognized by the United Nations as a Digital Public Good.

[Video 4](https://vimeo.com/814873471)

THE NATIONAL STANDARD

## LITE implements NEP 2020

The vision that we just demonstrated implements NEP 2020's goals for the next generation of classrooms. LITE implements this new combination of regulatory requirements to transform students into well-rounded, productive, and upstanding global citizens.

![Image 7: Illustration representing the goals of NEP 2020 for modern classrooms, focusing on the next generation's education and advancements in teaching methods and technologies.](https://pupilfirst.com/images/NEP-2020.webp)

A FULL-STACK APPROACH

## Aligning the ecosystem

The successful implementation of LITE hinges on well-trained teachers.We work with institutions to train their faculty members in the areas

Title: Open Source Systems & Learning Ecosystem

URL Source: https://www.rootsprouthub.com/

Markdown Content:
OPEN SOURCE SYSTEMS ECOSYSTEM

## Build. Break.   
Rebuild.   
Learn.

Rootsprouthub is a free, open-source platform founded by Meerthika SR that helps students and developers build low-level systems from scratch to understand production software architecture.

rootsprouthub v2.0.0

$npm install @rootsprouthub/core

... fetching low-level modules

Core engine initialized successfully

$rootsprouthub start --community

🚀 Launching open-source learning hub...

100+ GitHub Stars

500+ Community Members

⚡ 20+ Projects Built

Discover high-impact open source repositories maintained by the Rootsprouthub community.

![Image 1: Kira-Kafka](https://www.rootsprouthub.com/assets/1-Dda4O70m.png)

TRENDING REPO

### Kira-Kafka

A lightweight, educational distributed log system in C. Mimics the core of Apache Kafka — topics, partitions, brokers, disk-backed logs, zero-copy reads, memory-mapped I/O, log compression, and thread-to-core mapping.

![Image 2: Ge-Git](https://www.rootsprouthub.com/assets/2-Bp0igDKS.png)

### Ge-Git

Git implementation in C. Supports blob, tree, and commit objects, replicating Git’s internal object storage system.

![Image 3: Cow-Compiler](https://www.rootsprouthub.com/assets/3-LIMcRl09.png)

### Cow-Compiler

A compiler in C for a minimalistic language called CowLang. Compiles CowLang into LLVM IR.

Here is what software engineers, computer science researchers, and core maintainers say about Rootsprouthub.

5.0 Average Rating from Engineers

![Image 4: Aren Melinda Grace](https://www.rootsprouthub.com/assets/aren-Ds09jHgr.jpg)

#### Aren Melinda Grace

Final Year CS Student • Computer Science

"Building Kira-Kafka from scratch opened my eyes to zero-copy reads and memory-mapped I/O. Rootsprouthub is hands down the best place to understand production system internals!"

Kira-Kafka Project Verified Builder

![Image 5: Dharshana](https://www.rootsprouthub.com/assets/dharshana-D6QAYaES.jpg)

#### Dharshana

AI Engineer • Pinnacle Labs

"The NGINX internals book and Kernel Series filesystem breakdowns are masterclasses in first-principles engineering. Essential reading for every serious developer."

Kernel Series & NGINX Book Verified Builder

![Image 6: Muthuselvi](https://www.rootsprouthub.com/assets/muthuselvi-wBAtAeKB.jpg)

#### Muthuselvi

CS Researcher & Fellow • Systems & Architecture Lab

"Rootsprouthub bridges the gap between high-level frameworks and actual kernel-level execution. The hands-on C projects like AutoNormDB are phenomenal!"

AutoNormDB Engine Verified Builder

![Image 7: Ananya Sharma](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1494790108377-be9c29b29330?auto=format&fit=crop&q=80&w=200)

#### Ananya Sharma

Core Contributor • FOSS United

"The community hackathons and live workshops gave me the confidence to write custom Unix shells and understand OS process scheduling under the hood."

Exsh Shell Project Verified Builder

SIX SPECIALIZED INITIATIVES. ONE INTEGRATED OPEN SOURCE HUB.

![Image 8: SheBuilds code & connect](https://www.rootsprouthub.com/assets/1-B0g9TDnI.png)

![Image 9: FOSS United Madurai](https://www.rootsprouthub.com/assets/2-Bmu8fZYM.png)

![Image 10: SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Ramapuram](https://www.rootsprouthub.com/assets/3-F4497HvF.png)

![Image 11: SPEC NITH](https://www.rootsprouthub.com/assets/4-BkA9jP2-.png)

![Image 12: GDG KSRCE, KSR College Of Engineering](https://www.rootsprouthub.com/assets/5-C8iSzfhi.png)

![Image 13: Data Science Club - Panimalar,Chennai](https://www.rootsprouthub.com/assets/6-vbCgXjUA.png)

![Image 14: CYBRIAN](https://www.rootsprouthub.com/assets/6-DF4hZ-WM.png)

![Image 15: PEC Hacks](https://www.rootsprouthub.com/assets/8-S4RpOq9V.png)

![Image 16: CodeSapiens - the Student Community of Coders](https://www.rootsprouthub.com/assets/9-Bum5z-e6.png)

URL Source: https://vijevira.in/

Markdown Content:
## 👋 Hi, I'm Vijendra Kumar

I'm a **Senior Software Engineer at Apsona**, based in Bangalore, India, where I focus on **backend engineering, Salesforce automation,** and **DevOps** — things like Vault-based secrets management, triggered merge automation, and scheduler tooling.

My career started at **TCS** in 2021, and I later spent time at **Pratishthan Software Ventures** building real-time payment infrastructure for banks — **SEPA**, **SWIFT**, **NACH**, **QCBIP**, and **UAERT**. Outside my day job I build side projects, from multiplayer games to **AI-powered tools** and SaaS platforms, and I've solved **350+ coding problems** across various platforms.

### 🛠️ What I work with

*   Node.js, Python, TypeScript, Shell scripting
*   PostgreSQL, Redis, Node-RED
*   HashiCorp Vault, Salesforce, AWS Lambda/SQS
*   Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, Docker, Turborepo

### 🔗 Explore

*   📖 Read the full story on [About](https://vijevira.in/about)
*   💻 Browse what I've built in [Projects](https://vijevira.in/projects)
*   📄 See my full career history on my [Resume](https://vijevira.in/resume)

### 🚀 Let's Build Something Amazing

I'm always open to exciting collaborations, freelance gigs, or full-time roles where I can solve real problems, learn with smart folks, and make a meaningful impact. [Say hello](mailto:vijevira@engineer.com) — let's build something awesome together!
